definitions.full: H406. ikkar אִכָּר noun masculine Joel 1:11 ploughman, husband-man (Arabic , Aramaic , אִיבָּרָא , compare Mishna) ׳א singular absolute Jer 51:23 (+ וְצִמְדּוֺ ) Amos 5:16 ; plural אִכָּרִים Jer 14:4 ; 31:24 (|| בָעֵדֶר וְנָָֽסְעוּ ) 2Chr 26:10 (|| כֹּרְמִים ) Joel 1:11 (|| id. ,), אִכָּרֵיכֶם Isa 61:5 (|| id. ) אַכְשָׁף see כשׁף . I. אַל (= , Arabic article, preserved perhaps in following words derived by Hebrews from (or through) Arabic-speaking tribes; compare English algebra, Alhambra, alkali, alcohol, alcove , etc.)
